angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 14,054,531 km at 83.96 pc = 2.24 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 92845: distance 83.963 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.044), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 83.963 +/- 3.694 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 11.4104 +/- 0.7520 mas (same row, RUWE 5.28), 15.2 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 20.202 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 92845: radius 20.202 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 112.581 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.074) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 14,054,531 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4186 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 92845: effective temperature 4186 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.141) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 92845: effective temperature 4186 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.141) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433)
spectralTypeSource: SIMBAD, * nu.02 Sgr: spectral type K3-II-III:CN1Ba1 (1989ApJS...71..245K)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, * nu.02 Sgr: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, * nu.02 Sgr: projected rotation speed 4 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2005yCat.3244....0G)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.

surfaceGravitySource: log g 1.03 from 2014AJ....147..137L; the 3 published values span log g 1 to 1.07, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.0% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014AJ....147..137L)
